text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. 奶油色垂领挂脖短上衣胸中金扣及前摆开口，淡黄侧抽绳修身短裙。配饰：深棕编织单肩包；黑色窄框墨镜；金色小圆环耳饰。按自然穿搭位置或旁置排列，无人无人台。
original_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. One standalone photorealistic wardrobe catalogue product photo. Pure white seamless background, neutral soft studio lighting, realistic fabric texture. Portrait 2:3, full objects uncropped with comfortable margins. NO people, skin, body parts, face, hair, visible mannequin, hangers, stand, scene, text or watermark. Hollow invisible-mannequin presentation; see white background through sheer fabrics. Preserve the reference garment colors, silhouette, construction and fabric. Do not invent footwear when not visible. Reconstruct obscured seams conservatively. Reference image is design input only. Target ONLY image 22 position r1c3. rNcM means row N, column M, counted left to right, top to bottom across the full image. For images 27 and 28 there are 3 rows x 8 persons: each row joins two 4-person panels. For image 21 left/middle-left/middle-right/right are its four distinct clothing sets. For image 31 the left side has six dresses in two rows; right side has three people. For image 29 c1-c5 means its five main columns. For image 36 c4 bottom means the red lace dress in fourth column below a cropped advertisement; ignore cropped neighboring items. Ignore all other outfits, text and objects. Complete outfit cover: 奶油色垂领挂脖短上衣胸中金扣及前摆开口，淡黄侧抽绳修身短裙. Include ONLY these detachable accessories: 深棕编织单肩包；黑色窄框墨镜；金色小圆环耳饰. Arrange clothing as one coherent frontal hollow outfit and place the listed accessories beside it with clear spacing. No people, skin, additional items, jewelry not listed, or mannequin.
reproduction_note: 依据用户附件制作白底无人商品图；原附件仅作参考。遮挡处、微小首饰和未展示结构采用保守补全，不代表品牌或精确商品鉴定。文字图案以视觉参考为主，未逐图重生成验证。
